These commands are available three ways — in the FREE-WILi GUI app, in a serial
terminal, and on the device itself. See
[Connecting it to a computer](../start-here/connecting.md) for how to reach them.

## Enable Reader

Enable/disable NFC reader with auto tag streaming

**How to use it** — press `r`. At the prompt, enter: 1 to enable, 0 to disable.

**What you enter** — `enable`.

## Print Card Info

Display detailed info about detected card

**How to use it** — press `c`.

## Get Status (debug)

Display NFC hardware state and debug info

**How to use it** — press `g`.

**See also:** [NFC panel](../panels/nfc.md) — the on-screen panel for this.
